bio_en: Arshak Yeztanian, known as Yezid Arshak or Bitlistsi Arshak, came from a Bitlis family with a heroic past. In Constantinople during the Armistice period he was a devoted ARF member who led the 'Karkut' group and carried out the party's most dangerous orders. He shot dead the Hnchak leader and police informer Hmayak Aramiants on the Gedik Pasha slope and also punished the traitor known as 'Bulgarian Vladimir', both held responsible for the arrest and death of Armenians during the Genocide. He later lived in exile and died in Brussels on 9 January after a long illness.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Surname given as Yeztanian (#145) and Musheghian (#146). Death year from #146 (1959, also in its year list). Dates of the operations not stated - Armistice period (1918-1922).
